reuse.why: Hooks into the existing refuseAlreadyLinkedBankAccount wrapper that every *-accounts-link handler already goes through, and puts the check next to the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked in link.ts.

duplication.why: The closed rule is written once; the only redundancy is a second small account lookup alongside the one linkBankSyncAccount already does for upgradingId.

placement.why: The assertion lives in link.ts with the other link guards and is applied in the same pre-link guard layer the tree uses for the duplicate-link rule.

scope.why: Only the guard, its call and focused tests are added.

maintainability.why: Simple and central; the wrapper name refuseAlreadyLinkedBankAccount no longer describes everything it checks, which a maintainer may find slightly misleading.

one_place.where: link.assertAccountNotClosed, called from the shared refuseAlreadyLinkedBankAccount wrapper in accounts/app.ts that wraps all six link handlers.
